title: Unreal by Future Crew
summary: The first-place PC demo at Assembly 1992, Unreal by Future Crew, showing real-time effects such as palette-based wormholes.
why: Cited as a landmark demoscene piece that astonished people with what a PC could do.

quote.text: Half the things in XScreenSaver or Future Crew's Unreal were things it was really surprising to see
